counterfactual.change: Set actuated true->false only; fixed-time cycle removes early gap-out/recall preemption and yellow lasts full duration

explanation: Actuated control truncates EW yellow: EW green gaps out at step 81 (queues 0) while NS has waited ~60s, then yellow at step 82 goes red at step 83 after only 1s instead of 3s. Fixed-time with identical timings does not fail, so the actuated/recall transition logic is short-circuiting the yellow timer to serve the long-waiting NS direction.
vision_note: The EW approaches show green in steps 80-81, change to yellow in step 82, then are already all red in step 83. The yellow phase therefore lasts only one second instead of holding for the required duration.
